about: Features that hide Nama ERP screens, grids and fields. kind=feature: hidden while the feature is listed in Unused Features on the user's legal entity or on the Configuration Group (or switched off by the company licence on cloud servers). kind=module: shown only when that module is installed. kind=entity: shown only when that screen is available (licensed and not in Unused Entities). A Screen Modifier cannot show a field whose feature is unavailable.
